Name: Ryza Custom NPC
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
[size=1]oh goodness gracious I've done it again.

[/size][size=3]Ok folks, Y'all know the drill. (I assume...)
[/size][size=4]umm this mod contains a spider so if you have arachnophobia, maybe don't download this mod i guess...
[/size][size=3]
this mod currently adds:
[/size][size=2]1 NPC (roommate-able)
1 heart event[/size][size=2] (will add more later)[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]6 items[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]1 shirt[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]3 new location-map-thingies[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]over 100 lines of dialogue [/size][size=1](why do i do this to myself...)[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=2]1 conversation topic (so far)[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=4]💖Credit to FellowClown for making the portraits and sprites for Ryza!! Thank you so much!💖[/size][size=3]

[/size][size=5]REQUIREMENTS: [/size][size=3]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore (soft requirement)[/url]﻿
[size=5]
INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS: [/size]
[size=3]move the .zip file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, and extract the files[/size]


I only upload my mods on nexus. if you see my mods anywhere else, it means someone has stolen the file.

[size=3]please put bug reports in the bug report section, not under the comments![/size][size=4]
translation files are available, translators are welcome to make translations, if they wish to do so.

mods used in images: 
[/size]daisyniko's earthy recolor
overgrown flowery interface
cursers made cute
better friendship
